variant = "default"
budget = 200000

[methods.snake]
method = "dqn"
lr = 0.002

[check_settings.dqn]
epsilon_decay_steps = 500
hidden = 16
"""

    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_text(text)
    return path

    configs = load_run_configs(_write(tmp_path, SNAKE_TOML), [1, 2])

    assert [c.seed for c in configs] == [1, 2]
    assert all(c.world == "snake" and c.variant == "default" for c in configs)
    assert all(c.budget == 200000 and c.device == "cpu" for c in configs)

world = "prey"
